question: Sukta was known as the hymns of which of the following Vedic books?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rigveda**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sukta** refers to the **hymns or mantras** that are part of the **Rigveda**.
 
• The **Rigveda** is the **oldest Vedic text** and one of the most important scriptures of ancient Indian literature.
 
• It consists of **1028 hymns (Suktas)**, divided into **10 mandalas (books).**
 
• The hymns are primarily dedicated to various **deities such as Agni, Indra, Varuna, and Soma**.
 
• The **Rigveda** provides insights into the **social, religious, and economic conditions** of the early Vedic period.
 
• The hymns were composed in **Vedic Sanskrit** and were orally transmitted for centuries before being written down.
 
• The focus of the hymns is on **invoking divine forces** for blessings, prosperity, and protection.
 
• The **Rigveda** is considered the foundation of the other three Vedas: **Samaveda, Yajurveda, and Atharvaveda**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Atharvaveda**__

 __
 
• The **Atharvaveda** is the fourth Veda and contains hymns, spells, and incantations for **practical purposes such as healing, protection, and success in life.**
 
• It focuses on **everyday life** and includes topics such as **medicine, rituals, and magic.**
 
 
 
• **Samaveda**__
 __
 
• The **Samaveda** consists of hymns from the **Rigveda**, but they are set to **musical notations** and are meant to be sung during **rituals and sacrifices.**
 
• It is often referred to as the **"Veda of Melodies."**
 
 
 
• **Yajurveda**__
 
 
• The **Yajurveda** contains hymns and mantras necessary for performing **Vedic rituals and sacrifices.**
 
• It is divided into two main categories: **Shukla (White) Yajurveda** and **Krishna (Black) Yajurveda.**
